observations: Role 108 covers constrained foraging duration, mixture, catalog, deterministic sampling, quantity arithmetic and planner rights; source tests were read only. Current numeric ranges are separately bounded in ASSESSMENT-L1-FORAGING-BOUNDS.json.

Role 111 is preparation-action vocabulary with stable string IDs and numeric codes. Role 114 historically deserializes catalogue dimensions through CuboidDimensions, and role 115 historically projects generated weapon lengths and coverage; preserve that historic type ownership and do not treat it as current catalogue behavior.

Role 117 counts qualifying leader ballots and breaks ties by ID; a separately traced current public API and its stored-ballot producer retain an open duplicate-vote contract. Role 118 is the historic module and prelude export surface, not a body-level review of those modules. Role 120 supplies four historic authority-ID wrappers and bounded receipt constants; its separately inspected current Serde admission path is recorded without promoting this historical body.
